Mathlib's `aeval_algHom_apply` needs an AlgHom, and no AlgHom version of these maps is available in this file. An `qExpandAlgHomC` exists in Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_X0ModL.lean, but this file does not import it and there is no AlgHom for qTwist. I did not claim any other duplication. The F2/F3/F4 root-product steps and the `key` calculation are used once each. I could not compile the proposed lemmas, so they are untested. The `qExpand_C` implicit-argument unification in the second use is the main uncertainty.

findings.problem: qTwist_aeval and qExpand_aeval have the same proof: unfold aeval to eval₂, push the ring hom through with hom_eval₂, then check that the two ring homs agree on constants via algebraMap_eq_C. Only the final lemma differs (qTwist_C versus qExpand_C). The main proof repeats the same pattern three times in F5, F6 and F7. Each time it applies congrArg of a constant-fixing ring hom to hstar, then runs `map_mul, map_pow, map_one, <x>_aeval`. The proof of the transport of `aeval G * 𝓓^M = 1` along such a ring hom is therefore written three times.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one general lemma in the Kit section:

theorem map_aeval_of_C (f : LaurentSeries K →+* LaurentSeries K) (hf : ∀ c : K, f (HahnSeries.C c) = HahnSeries.C c) (x : LaurentSeries K) (P : Polynomial K) : f (Polynomial.aeval x P) = Polynomial.aeval (f x) P := by
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.hom_eval₂]
  congr 1
  exact RingHom.ext fun c => by rw [RingHom.comp_apply, algebraMap_eq_C, hf]

Then qTwist_aeval u x P := map_aeval_of_C (qTwist u) (qTwist_C K u) x P, and qExpand_aeval N x P := map_aeval_of_C (qExpand K N) (fun c => qExpand_C c) x P.

Also add a transport lemma:

theorem aeval_mul_pow_eq_one_map (f : LaurentSeries K →+* LaurentSeries K) (hf : ∀ c : K, f (HahnSeries.C c) = HahnSeries.C c) {G : Polynomial K} {D : LaurentSeries K} {M : ℕ} (h : Polynomial.aeval (jqModC K) G * D ^ M = 1) : Polynomial.aeval (f (jqModC K)) G * f D ^ M = 1 := by
  have h' := congrArg f h
  rwa [map_mul, map_pow, map_one, map_aeval_of_C f hf] at h'

F6 becomes `aeval_mul_pow_eq_one_map (qExpand K p) (fun c => qExpand_C c) hstar` (with `hjp` to rewrite `qExpand K p (jqModC K)` to `jqNModC K p`). F7 is the same with p*p. F5 applies it inside `Finset.prod_eq_one` with `qTwist (ζ ^ b)` and `qTwist_C`.
findings.benefit: Two near-identical proofs become one proof plus two one-line instances. The three 3-line hstar-transport blocks in the long main proof become one-line calls. A future constant-fixing ring hom (for example another Frobenius-type twist) gets the aeval compatibility without a new copy of the argument. The main proof also gets shorter and more readable.
